name: Content at Scale
tagline: Content at Scale generates long-form, research-backed blog posts from a keyword, URL, or YouTube video that are designed to pass AI detection tools. It synthesises information from multiple web sources, structures articles with proper headings, and delivers SEO-optimised drafts. Agencies use it to produce hundreds of articles per month.
